description: This file contains shell script code to test the functionality of 'git branch --track' command and related branch checkout behaviors in Git, including setup, checking out branches with tracking options, and configuration overrides.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, takes a description and a series of shell commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content or message for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches output or files for a specific pattern, used to verify error messages.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets Git configuration variables for testing scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares Git configuration variables between expected and actual.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
